deployments_detail.use: Syensqo.AI platform combining AI with R&D for next-generation material discovery, including generative AI for molecule creation and AI-powered polymer discovery
Memorandum of Understanding with Microsoft as main chemical-industry partner for the Microsoft Discovery platform, expanding generative AI and cloud for materials innovation

Use of Microsoft Discovery agentic AI platform to screen millions of molecular candidates and predict key properties (e.g. thermal performance) for bio-based polymers, circular composites and clean-energy materials. Syensqo is Microsoft's main chemical-industry development partner for Discovery. [Microsoft Discovery (Azure agentic AI)]

Deployment of the Citrine Informatics materials-informatics platform across polymer R&D, using AI to recommend formulations, reduce experiments and accelerate development of sustainable polymers. [Citrine Informatics]

'Syrup' — a fully automated robotic testing/formulation platform for Home & Personal Care and Agro labs that unseals vials, measures viscosity and pH, photographs, rinses and stores data autonomously, accelerating formulation research.

AI-designed bio-sourced scalp-care active (Re2 Coffea Arabica Peptide) developed with partner Bota Biosciences using its AI-driven Biofoundry platform to screen natural coffee proteins and select the most beneficial peptide sequences. [Bota Biosciences (AI Biofoundry platform)]

Joint AI Lab with Morocco's UM6P to develop next-generation agentic AI technologies for chemistry and materials science, translating research into sustainable industrial and environmental solutions. [UM6P (academic partner)]
AI-driven discovery and research acceleration for materials science [Microsoft]
AI for polymer discovery, experiment optimization, and next-generation materials development

SyGPT — internal generative AI chatbot that lets employees securely query data across company applications, databases and storage services to speed up decision-making. Built with Microsoft and integrator ExakisNelite; tested with 80 users before rollout to the 13,000+ workforce. [Microsoft Azure OpenAI Service, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure API Management; ExakisNelite]

Seeq Industrial Analytics & AI Suite used for manufacturing digital transformation — advanced/ML analytics on time-series process data for monitoring, quality and savings capture across plants. [Seeq]

SyGrow — AI-driven commercial/lead-generation tool that analyzes customer data to identify new prospects, streamline meeting preparation and increase customer-facing time for sales teams. [Microsoft (Azure / agentic AI)]
